headline: Probability measures likelihood—the math of how often things happen given what's possible
universal_truth: Not everything is equally likely; understanding odds helps you bet wisely on life
fun_facts: You're more likely to be struck by lightning than win a major lottery jackpot
The probability of flipping 10 heads in a row is about 1 in 1,000
Humans are notoriously bad at intuiting probability—we consistently misjudge odds
discussion_questions: What odds are you playing in your current decisions?
Where do you overestimate or underestimate probability?
How would better probability intuition change your choices?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Will it rain? Will you get the job? Will this investment pay off? Life is filled with uncertainty—but not all outcomes are equally likely. Probability measures how often things happen given what's possible. It's the math of betting on the future.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: We make probability judgments constantly, usually poorly. Why is understanding probability so important?

options.text: Probability calibrates expectations to reality—understanding odds helps you bet on likely outcomes, avoid unlikely traps, and make decisions that work over time
options.response: Yes. Life is about playing odds. Good probability intuition means making choices that work out more often than not. It's not about certainty—it's about playing the numbers wisely.
It does predict random events, but applies more broadly to any uncertain outcome...

q1.title: Base Rates Matter
q1.script: How likely something is starts with how often it happens normally—the base rate. Before asking 'could this happen to me?', ask 'how often does this happen at all?' Base rates anchor probability.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Base Rates Matter"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Human Bias
q2.script: We're bad at probability. We overweight dramatic events, underweight common ones. We think rare things are common if we've seen them recently. Knowing your biases improves your odds.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Playing the Odds
q3.script: Good decisions play favorable odds repeatedly. You'll still lose sometimes, but probability favors you over time. Make choices with good odds, accept individual losses, trust the numbers.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Not everything is equally likely. Understanding odds helps you bet wisely on life. Learn to play probability.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 301. Tomorrow, we'll explore finding patterns in numbers—statistics. Until then, consider the odds you're playing in your current decisions.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Odds Assessment - What Are You Betting On?
growTrack.activity: Pick a decision you're facing. What's the probability of different outcomes? Are you overestimating unlikely scenarios or underestimating likely ones? How do the actual odds compare to your gut feeling?
